description: The title a student reads on a card. The search index must store this, not the stored `name`, because `name` carries a synthesized "<Person> Faculty Research" suffix that the client has always stripped for display. Implemented in client/src/utils/researchEntityCopy.ts (researchEntityTitle) and server/src/utils/servedResearchEntityTitle.ts (servedResearchEntityTitle). Both sides run these cases; changing a rule requires changing both and this file together.

cases.why: the synthesized roster title: suffix stripped, person kept
a bare Research suffix is stripped too
kind individual takes the same rule as the entityType
a real lab name is never stripped, because it is not a faculty research area
a named centre keeps a trailing Research, because the word is part of its name
stripping must not empty the title: a name that is only the suffix falls back
displayName wins over name when it grafts no lab structure
a displayName claiming a lab the name does not is a graft, so name is used
a faculty research area whose own name states a lab keeps it
no name at all yields an empty title rather than throwing
